about: Rule-based suitability masks, one per use. NO composite habitability score. Thresholds are assumed — editable (zones.py ZONE_CONFIG). robust = same rules with worst-case slope θ+kσθ. robust/nominal ratio = sensitivity under stated assumptions, not a probability.

grid.mask_encoding: run lengths over the row-major grid: [first_value, run1, run2, ...], runs alternate value
grid.authority: masks are authoritative; grids are uint16-quantized for popup values only. Recomputing zones from them flips <0.2% of boundary cells — never do that.

ice_interpretation.label: INTERPRETATION — ice-rich flow lobes (not a measurement)
ice_interpretation.digitized_by: Claude (AI assistant), 2026-11-14, by eye from HiRISE hillshade (DTEEC_041222_2210_040787_2210_A01) and ortho (ESP_041222_2210_RED_C_01)
ice_interpretation.basis: Raised lobate units with steep, sharp margins and knobby/pitted surface texture, interpreted as ice-rich debris-covered flow (lobate debris apron / lineated flow lobe) units. Radar evidence for ice in Deuteronilus aprons: Plaut et al. 2009, GRL, doi:10.1029/2008GL036379 (regional; no SHARAD track crosses this DTM).
ice_interpretation.excluded: The lineated band crossing rows ~6500-8200 is left out to keep the mask conservative.
